newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS MONDAY STABLE TO WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS MONDAY STABLE TO WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted steady on the U.S. dollar but slightly weaker on European currencies and South Africa's rand in fairly quiet Monday morning interbank trade.
Dealers said the local unit lost half a cent from its opening levels against the U.S. unit before the central Reserve Bank intervened to nudge it back up.
"It looks like they are happy to see it around these current levels," one dealer said.
"There isn't much happening in the market really. The slight pressure we saw earlier on was just people trying to protect their positions," added another.
At around 0755 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was at Friday's 11.2800/2900 against the U.S. dollar after having dipped to 11.2850/2950 earlier.
It eased against sterling to 18.3610/3880 from 18.3210/3490; to 6.5480/5550 versus the mark from 6.5440/5520 and was also quoted softer on the rand at 2.5340/5520 compared to 2.5310/5350.
